entities.name: Brenalt
entities.description: A young soldier who survives an undead ambush by making a pact with an angel, rises to general, and ends the story preparing a last charge against the undead.

entities.name: Inquisitor
entities.description: A stern inquisitor who questions Brenalt in his hospital bed and decides to believe his story.

entities.name: Mattias
entities.description: A dying soldier in Brenalt's squad who tells him to run.

entities.name: Tomas
entities.description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

entities.name: Edrick
entities.description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

entities.name: Stanton
entities.description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

entities.name: General Elise
entities.description: A general at the war council who judges River's Glen not strategically important.

entities.name: Angel
entities.description: An alien and benevolent angel who answers Brenalt's prayer in the ruined shrine and grants him strength.

entities.name: Necromancer
entities.description: A gaunt, powerful man in silks escorted by skeletal servants, seen driving the undead at the end.

entities.name: Undead
entities.description: The endless armies of the dead that overrun humanity's holdings and rise again from the fallen.

entities.name: Fourth Legion
entities.description: A human legion reported lost to the undead.

entities.name: River's Glen
entities.description: Brenalt's home, overrun by the dead.

entities.name: Greenfield
entities.description: A holding evacuated before being overrun by the dead.

entities.name: Eastern Tower
entities.description: A holding expected to be pressured by refugees from Greenfield.

events.summary: An inquisitor demands that the wounded Brenalt explain how he survived, suspecting a deal with a demon.
events.quote: I believe you made a deal for your life, and the seed of darkness is now within you.

events.summary: In a flashback, Brenalt barricades a ruined shrine and mourns his dead friends Tomas, Edrick and Stanton.
events.quote: Tomas, Edrick, and Stanton were dead. His best friends.

events.summary: Mattias dies after urging Brenalt to run and tell their families.
events.quote: Mattias's eyes shut and did not open again.

events.summary: Brenalt prays wordlessly at the altar and an angel appears in warmth and light.
events.quote: This was a creature from a different world, as alien in thought and mind as she was familiar in form.

events.summary: Brenalt asks the angel for help, and she nods, granting him strength in a pact.
The inquisitor, softened, tells Brenalt she believes him.
Brenalt rises rapidly through the ranks to general, rumored to be blessed by the angels.
events.quote: General Brenalt had been blessed by the angels, and no matter how bad it got, Brenalt managed to emerge victorious.

events.summary: At a council of war Brenalt tells his fellow commanders that angels are alien and cannot be relied on, not even for hope.
events.quote: The angels answered my call once, and whatever they are, I still believe that they might come to our aid.

events.summary: A scout reports that the Fourth Legion is lost and River's Glen overrun, and Brenalt reveals it was his home.
events.quote: The Fourth Legion is lost. The dead have overrun both Greenfield and River's Glen.

events.summary: Brenalt, now crippled and leading a few dozen survivors, sees a necromancer directing the dead below.
events.quote: The necromancer was real, after all.

events.summary: Brenalt screams at the heavens that he gave everything and will die fighting, honoring his promise.
events.quote: I will die fighting. I will die honoring my promise to you.

events.summary: Brenalt bows his head with the praying refugees and raises his staff for one last charge as the wind changes.
events.quote: He raised his staff toward the enemy, girding himself for one last charge.

relations.note: He makes a pact with her.
Squadmate who dies in his arms.
relations.quote: Brenalt's waterskin was mostly empty, but he eased a few last drops into Mattias's mouth.

relations.note: He faces the necromancer's undead armies.
relations.quote: Down the valley below, he saw a gaunt man wrapped in silks, escorted by dozens of skeletal servants.

relations.note: Brenalt takes him for the driving force behind the dead.
relations.quote: The existence of a necromancer or demon as the driving force behind the enemy had been theorized

relations.note: He answers to the inquisitor's questioning.
relations.quote: "Explain to me how you survived, Soldier."
